item.title: Hubble 1.2.0
item.description:
Hubble 1.2.0
Hubble 1.2.0: workspace-local modules and per-action LiveGrade targets
Keep each workspace’s configured modules local, preserving saved settings, module assignments, action selections, slot values, and formulas during the upgrade. Copy configured modules from another workspace when needed.
Use one module name and one Save Changes button. Choose LiveGrade Pro 6, Studio 6, LiveGrade 7, or Frontier per action, with smart slot values retained when switching applications. Existing actions keep their saved application targets.
